given_when_then.given: A perishable item has approaching expiration dates
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to allocate an Order Request for that SKU
given_when_then.then: The system shall prioritize the allocation to the Order Request over items with further expiration dates based on freshness status

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner updates the quantity of a perishable SKU in their Real-Time Inventory Snapshot
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to allocate an Order Request for that SKU
given_when_then.then: The system shall reflect the updated quantity immediately and allow allocation only if stock is sufficient

given_when_then.given: An Order Request has successfully locked stock for a perishable item
given_when_then.when: The customer cancels the Order Request before the fulfillment task begins
given_when_then.then: The system shall release the locked stock quantity back to the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot for other orders

given_when_then.given: A Store Partner updates the quantity of a perishable SKU in their Real-Time Inventory Snapshot
given_when_then.when: The data link latency exceeds the defined threshold or a sync failure is detected
given_when_then.then: The system shall flag a synchronization discrepancy

given_when_then.given: An Order Request is not confirmed within the allocated time window after locking stock
given_when_then.when: The system evaluates the state of the locked inventory
given_when_then.then: The system shall automatically release the locked stock quantity back to the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot

success_criteria: The system shall prioritize allocation of perishable inventory based on proximity to expiration date.
The system shall reflect updated perishable inventory quantities immediately when a Store Partner updates the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
The system shall allow allocation only if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows sufficient stock quantity.
The system shall flag a synchronization discrepancy if data link latency exceeds the defined threshold or if a sync failure is detected.
The system shall automatically release locked stock if an Order Request is not confirmed within the allocated time window.
